kind: REQ17/CHAT06 bounded measurement acceptance research; proposal only
mapping: Existing GO REQ17/Web performance + CHAT06; manager maps to existing local WPF-REQ-17/WPF-REQ-21/MATURE06-03 without inventing another framework or task layer.

measurementContract.acceptance: Count the BufferSource byte length delivered to actual SHA-256 per executed call, with identity, patch-fingerprint, full-prefix and unknown categories kept distinct. Preserve actual digest result/rejection. Fixture generation/expected digests and summary hashing must not contaminate measured ingestion. Prefix arithmetic is a prediction only; replay computes identity/fingerprint but skips sealed content reconstruction. Any unclassified calls stay explicit.

Observe the actual installed parsing entry, counting invocations and UTF-8 input bytes even for render attempts later abandoned. Remark transformer callbacks happen after parsing and cannot alone measure parse entry/duration. Counting message events, network patches or component renders is not a parser count. Instrumentation must be transparent, bounded and removable; do not replace the implementation with a hand-copied parser.

Use actual Profiler onRender commits, retaining phase/actualDuration/commitTime. Deduplicate nested records by profiler identity plus shared commitTime when aggregating; parse attempts remain a separate series. Declare exact build mode/profiling configuration because normal production profiling is disabled; development StrictMode work must not be presented as normal production cost.

Use owned fixture composer keystrokes which do not submit. Capture Event Timing input queue delay processingStart-startTime when supported, correlate target/interaction, and report filtering threshold, rounded duration and missing samples. No entry does not mean zero latency. A fallback event-handler-to-value-commit measurement must be named as that narrower metric, never full input-to-paint or product INP. Playwright command wall time includes automation overhead and is not the browser metric.

Record patch arrival, verified state application, actual parse attempt, React commit, terminal stream receipt and display catch-up separately. smooth/defer may skip or add intermediate display work; do not impose patch count = parse count = commit count. Wait for exact final text/renderer settled state or mark incomplete rather than using network terminal alone.

boundedScenarioProposal.pairedInputs: Within each family preserve exact final UTF-8 text/hash and total byte count; vary patch partition/count/cadence. The source-analysis stress comparison is 128 versus 4096 equal-sized patches. It is not an approved run matrix or measured result.
boundedScenarioProposal.limits: Respect <=1 MiB aggregate attempt, <=4096 total accepted patches including any terminal patch, <=8 patches/page, legal UTF-8 boundaries and unchanged identity/revision/replay rules. If final phase needs its own patch, allocate it inside the existing cap rather than silently creating patch4097.
boundedScenarioProposal.cadence: Record proposed schedule and observed enqueue/apply times; hold the declared schedule duration and final content constant for the intended comparison. Report timer drift/coalescing and batch boundaries, never infer frame work from network frequency.
boundedScenarioProposal.firstAdmission: First future run should admit one named pair and bounded data/trace/cleanup limits. Expand only on evidence and explicit available resources, not an automatic full factorial suite.
boundedScenarioProposal.outputBound: Aggregate exact call/byte counters; retain only bounded timing samples and identify overflow/censoring. Do not copy every full prefix into trace output. Store one final fixture plus its hash and metadata instead of O(prefix-count * final-size) raw logs.

semanticGates: Existing full SHA-256 checks, identity, replay rejection, offsets, unknown/recovery and final settlement remain unchanged; no skip-verification or hash-semantic change.

Before speed comparison, check exact final/raw text remains reachable, fenced-code clipboard content preserves full code and line breaks, and GFM table headers/cells/order/accessibility semantics remain intact.

Record current smooth/defer behavior as baseline. Any comparison changing them must also report display catch-up and terminal status semantics; fewer displayed intermediates alone does not prove cheaper parsing.
Use the actual assistant-ui Thread/part context and its current renderer. A standalone alternate renderer is a separate experiment and cannot replace current product acceptance.

No Streamdown/hash-library upgrade is selected. Shared interaction instrumentation or production changes belong to its original owner; Web may propose an isolated fixture consumer in its own later claimed scope.

arithmeticOnly.formula: For N bytes in K equal append patches, sum of full prefixes is N*(K+1)/2; excludes identity/fingerprint/terminal/replay hashing.

officialReferences.use: Current docs index checked per local skill; not evidence of installed package behavior.
Renderer belongs to runtime text-part context; modern documentation is not a substitute for installed version source.
Alternative renderer guide only; no migration chosen or installed.
onRender identifies actual committed updates; profiling overhead and production-build caveat.
Deferred render attempts can be interrupted/restarted and are distinct from request counts.
Input delay formula, entry support/threshold and rounded duration; missing entries are censored, not zero.

findings: Keep digest/parser/commit/input timelines distinct instead of a generic performance success flag.
Use actual source seams and lossless aggregates rather than copied implementations or unbounded full-prefix logs.
cleanCode.fixes: Acceptance/interface proposal only; no code or protocol change.
cleanCode.unresolved: Exact instrumentation hook compatibility and all performance/semantic runtime results remain unverified.
